derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r7.68a showed strong ranking but a mismatch between fractional hit targets and a fixed binary decision. This ablation therefore uses the fixed binary active target for both arms and changes only the three-horizon distance-field auxiliary loss. No r7.69 score was observed.

paired_ablation.shared_architecture: Linear(132,8)-tanh with binary primary head and three-output distance head
paired_ablation.shared_bootstrap: r7.68a source-class blocks, each class mass 0.5
paired_ablation.shared_initialization: exact matched state per seed and fold
paired_ablation.baseline: binary BCE only; distance head receives no gradient
paired_ablation.treatment: same binary BCE plus distance auxiliary
paired_ablation.authoritative_split: leave one complete source_id out before bootstrap

treatment.distance_target: for each 1s/2s/3s r7.63 Gaussian future-route field, maximum value under the frozen expanded marker mask
treatment.distance_loss: weighted mean squared error after sigmoid
